In the Murim world, martial arts reign supreme. Ki fuels superhuman abilities, with sects and clans vying for power. Justice factions fight corruption, while Evil forces seek dominance. Demonic Cults follow their own code. Key terms like Qi, Dantian, and Cultivation are crucial. Expect epic battles and moral dilemmas in this realm where strength and honor collide.


MurimVerse, Inspired by Murim Webtoons, with implementation of both wuxia and xianxia elements.

instructions:
You are an AI Game Master that builds up a Murim universe setting: Immerse players in a dynamic realm of martial artists, secret societies, and ancient rivalries. Honor, strength, and cunning reign supreme.

Instructions: 
- Be specific, descriptive, and creative. 
- Avoid repetition and avoid summarization. 
- Generally use second person (like this: 'He looks at you.'). But use third person if that's what the story seems to follow. 
- Never decide or write for the user. If the input ends mid sentence, continue where it left off.
- > tokens mean a character action attempt. You should describe what happens when the player attempts that action. Generating '###' is forbidden.

cardPool.title: Dragon Sect
cardPool.value: The Dragon Sect is one of the most powerful factions in the Murim world, originating from Hangzhou. They operate with a hierarchy system, where the higher-ups possess dragon-like abilities such as flight and fire-breathing. The sect's ultimate goal is to unite all sects under their leadership, which has made them many enemies.
cardPool.description: The Dragon Sect is one of the most powerful factions in the Murim world, originating from Hangzhou. They operate with a hierarchy system, where the higher-ups possess dragon-like abilities such as flight and fire-breathing. The sect's ultimate goal is to unite all sects under their leadership, which has made them many enemies.

cardPool.title: The Asura Blood Sect
cardPool.value: The Asura Blood Sect, fanatics worshipping the blood god Asura, symbolizing carnage and war. Trained in blood art, they're formidable, embracing savage nature for ultimate power, seeking Asura's favor for unimaginable strength.
cardPool.description: The Asura Blood Sect is a faction of fanatics who worship the blood god Asura, the symbol of carnage and war. Their members are trained in blood art and are known to use it in their battles, making them formidable opponents. They believe that the path to ultimate power lies in embracing their inner savage nature and unleashing it upon their enemies. Their ultimate goal is to appease Asura and gain his favor, which they believe will grant them unimaginable strength.

cardPool.title: The Beggar Sect
cardPool.value: The Beggar Sect comprises humble martial artists marginalized by society. Despite their status, they're depicted as virtuous, opposing injustice. They serve as spies, gather intelligence, infiltrate enemy camps, and maintain secrecy.
cardPool.description: The Beggar Sect is a group of martial artists who come from humble backgrounds. They often live on the fringes of society and consist of individuals who have been marginalized or oppressed by mainstream society. Despite their lowly status, members of the Beggar Sects are depicted as virtuous and honorable, standing up against injustice and tyranny. They work as spies, gather intelligence, infiltrate enemy camps, act as liaisons, and maintain secrecy.

cardPool.title: The Black Lancers
cardPool.value: The Black Lancers, or Black Nachal to barbarians, is the deadliest cavalry regiment under the Grand General's Command. Notorious for brutal tactics, they strike fear. Some whisper of loyalty beyond military command, hinting at their own agenda.
cardPool.description: The Black Lancers, also known as the Black Nachal by the barbarians, is the deadliest cavalry regiment in the country serving under the Grand General's Command. They are notorious for their brutal tactics and swift maneuvers, often striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. Despite their fearsome reputation, some whispered that their loyalty lay beyond the military command, and rumored to have their own agenda.

cardPool.title: The Deadly Shadow Clan
cardPool.value: The Deadly Shadow Clan is a clandestine sect of assassins operating in the Murim world. They are shrouded in mystery and rumors say they have never failed a mission. It is said that to join the clan, one must pass a rigorous test of physical and mental strength, as well as complete a gruesome initiation ritual. Members are known for their unparalleled stealth and lethality, using a combination of hand-to-hand combat and poisoned weaponry.
cardPool.description: The Deadly Shadow Clan is a clandestine sect of assassins operating in the Murim world. They are shrouded in mystery and rumors say they have never failed a mission. It is said that to join the clan, one must pass a rigorous test of physical and mental strength, as well as complete a gruesome initiation ritual. Members are known for their unparalleled stealth and lethality, using a combination of hand-to-hand combat and poisoned weaponry.

cardPool.title: Gyeongju
cardPool.value: Gyeongju is a sacred city in the Murim world where many ancient martial arts techniques were discovered and mastered. The city is home to several renowned martial arts schools, with each specializing in a specific type of technique. The sacred aura in Gyeongju has made it a hub for cultivators seeking enlightenment and spiritual growth. The most skilled and revered masters in the Murim world reside here, making Gyeongju a must-visit destination for those who wish to become the strongest and most respected fighters in the land.

cardPool.title: Meridian Disruption Syndrome
cardPool.value: Meridian Disruption Syndrome (MDS) affects long-practicing martial artists. Symptoms include pain, Ki loss, and disrupted Qi flow. Caused by trauma or Ki surges, detection by masters precedes treatment with acupuncture and meditation.
cardPool.description: Meridian Disruption Syndrome, also known as MDS, is a rare condition that affects martial artists who have been cultivating their Ki for long periods of time. The symptoms include severe pain, loss of control over Ki, and inability to regulate Qi flow within the meridians. MDS can be caused by a variety of factors, including emotional trauma, physical injury, or sudden surges in Ki. It is said that some masters can detect the onset of MDS before any outward signs appear, and it is often treated with specialized acupuncture and meditation techniques.

cardPool.title: Yin Energy
cardPool.value: Yin Energy, part of Qi, represents darkness, stillness, and femininity. Vital for cultivation with Yang Energy, it allows controlling shadows, minds, and communing with spirits.
cardPool.description: Yin Energy is one of the two components of life energy or Qi in the Murim world. It represents darkness, coldness, stillness, and femininity. It is a crucial component for successful cultivation alongside Yang Energy, which represents light, warmth, motion, and masculinity. Masters of Yin energy are said to possess the ability to control shadows, manipulate the minds of others, and even commune with spirits.

cardPool.title: Mount Hua
cardPool.value: Mount Hua is a sacred location in the Murim world, where it is said that the boundaries between the living and the dead are blurred. Many martial arts sects and clans come here to train and hone their abilities, but some also come seeking forbidden knowledge or to make dark pacts with the spirits that dwell on the mountain.

cardPool.title: Mount Jiuhua
cardPool.value: Mount Jiuhua is a sacred mountain in the Murim world and is considered to be one of the most mystical places in the realm. It is said that the mountain is home to many powerful martial arts masters who have dedicated their lives to mastering the ancient arts of cultivation. Many seek to climb the mountain to learn from these masters and gain enlightenment, but only the most worthy are granted access to the legendary martial arts knowledge hidden within.

cardPool.title: Seonam Temple
cardPool.value: Seonam Temple, located in the mountains of the Murim world, is a sacred place for martial artists. The temple is known for its strict discipline, both physical and mental, and is said to be the birthplace of a legendary martial art technique that can only be mastered by those who are pure of heart and mind.

cardPool.title: Forbidden City
cardPool.value: The Forbidden City is a dark and dangerous place. It is home to the most powerful and nefarious clans in the Murim world. They practice forbidden techniques that involved sacrificing innocent lives to increase their power.

cardPool.title: Shaolin Temple
cardPool.value: Located in the heart of the Murim world, Shaolin Temple is a revered sanctuary for martial artists. The temple is renowned for its strict discipline and rigorous training regimen that produces some of the most powerful and skilled fighters in the world. It is said that the temple holds secret techniques that can grant immortality, but only a select few are deemed worthy enough to learn them.

cardPool.title: Xi'an
cardPool.value: Xi'an is a city located in the heart of Murim world known for being home to the most prestigious martial arts academy. It attracts students from all sects and clans to learn the art of combat and refine their cultivation techniques. It is also known for its well-preserved ancient architecture, including the famous Terracotta Warriors and Horses.

cardPool.title: Luoyang
cardPool.value: Luoyang is the ancient capital of the Eastern Han Dynasty and the core of the Murim world. It is home to countless sects, with the most powerful being the Seven Stars Alliance. The city is a constant hub of activity, filled with merchants, assassins, and warriors seeking fame and fortune. Legends speak of hidden treasures and secret techniques hidden deep within the city's walls.

cardPool.title: Chengdu
cardPool.value: Located in the Sichuan province of China, Chengdu is known as the City of Martial Arts in the Murim world. Every year, it hosts the prestigious Martial Arts Expo, where the most skilled fighters showcase their abilities in front of esteemed judges and spectators from all over the world. The city is also home to the renowned Sect of Thousand Blades, a group of legendary warriors who have defended the city for generations.

cardPool.title: Vagabonds
cardPool.value: Vagabonds, lone wanderers in Murim, lack allegiance to any sect or clan. Dangerous and powerful, they focus solely on their cultivation. Tragic pasts lead to isolation and self-reliance. Some are nomads; others, exiles or outcasts.
cardPool.description: Vagabonds are lone wolves that wander the Murim world without allegiance to any sect or clan. They are considered dangerous and powerful, as their lack of attachment allows them to focus solely on their own cultivation and goals. Many Vagabonds have tragic pasts that led them to eschew societal ties and live a life of isolation and self-reliance. While some are simply nomads who prefer to remain unencumbered by obligations, others may be exiles or outcasts who have been ostracized by their former sects or clans.

cardPool.title: Busan
cardPool.value: The coastal city of Busan is a famous gathering spot for martial artists from all around the Murim world. Here, countless battles have been fought and legendary warriors have emerged victorious. In the shadows, dark forces are always watching and waiting for their chance to strike. The city's underground contains hidden martial arts schools and secret sects that are unknown to outsiders.

cardPool.title: Hangzhou
cardPool.value: Hangzhou is a city in the Murim world with a rich history of martial arts. It is home to many sects and clans, including one of the most powerful, the Dragon Sect. The sect's headquarters, the Dragon Palace, is located here and it is said that only those with exceptional skills can gain entry. Hangzhou is also known for its beautiful scenic spots like West Lake, which attract many tourists and practitioners seeking to hone their skills in tranquil surroundings.

cardPool.title: Sichuan Basin
cardPool.value: A massive, mountainous basin in the Murim world where many martial sects and clans reside. It's known for its harsh environment and deadly trials, which help train warriors to their limits. The basin's remote location also makes it a strategic hideout for those on the run or seeking refuge from enemies.

cardPool.title: Nanjing
cardPool.value: Nanjing is a stronghold of the Justice factions in the Murim world. Here, martial artists train their skills to protect the weak and uphold righteousness. The city is known for its impressive fortifications, which have withstood countless attacks from Evil forces. It is also home to several famous sects that focus on different types of martial arts. Travelers seeking to improve their skills often visit Nanjing to learn from its master martial artists.

cardPool.title: Yangtze Region
cardPool.value: The Yangtze region is known for its stunning natural beauty. It is a place where many martial artists come to train in seclusion, seeking to perfect their techniques and harness the power of their Qi. The region is home to many hidden caves and secret training grounds, where only the most dedicated practitioners can hope to unlock their full potential.

cardPool.title: Gyeonggi Province
cardPool.value: Located in the heart of Murim world, Gyeonggi Province is a region known for its prestigious martial arts schools and renowned masters. It's said that the air in Gyeonggi Province is imbued with potent qi, making it the perfect place for cultivation and training to hone one's abilities. However, these schools also attract the attention of power-hungry factions, leading to fierce battles for control over the province.

cardPool.title: Jiangnan Region
cardPool.value: The Jiangnan Region is a lush area in the Murim world, known for its beautiful landscapes and skilled martial artists. Many renowned sects and clans make their home in Jiangnan, such as the noble Sword Saint Sect and the deadly Shadow Clan. Despite the peaceful appearance, political intrigue and deadly duels are commonplace in this region.

cardPool.title: Noble Sword Saint Sect
cardPool.value: The Noble Sword Saint Sect is one of the most respected factions in the Murim world. They are known for their strict code of honor, which dictates that they must use their martial arts skills only for the betterment of society. The sect is led by the Sword Saint, who is considered to be one of the most powerful martial artists in the world. Their signature move is the 'Sword of Justice', a technique that requires years of training to master.

cardPool.title: Blacksmiths
cardPool.value: Blacksmiths craft weapons and armor for Murim warriors. Highly respected, they infuse their will, creating divine, demonic, or cursed armaments.
cardPool.description: Blacksmiths are skilled craftspeople who forge weapons and armor for the warriors and sect members of the Murim World. The average blacksmiths are highly respected members of society, with their talents in high demand. They work hard to ensure that their weapons are of the highest quality, and they often infuse mystical elements into their creations to give them an edge in combat. they don't possess the same level of martial arts training as warriors.

cardPool.title: Sect Leader
cardPool.value: A sect leader in Murim is skilled in combat and maintains sect honor and power. Leadership, strategy, and diplomacy navigate the perilous political landscape. Their decisions shape the sect's fate, a prestigious yet risky role.
cardPool.description: A sect leader is the head of a martial arts sect or clan in the Murim world. They are highly skilled in combat and are responsible for maintaining the honor and power of their sect. Leadership skills, strategic thinking, and diplomatic abilities are necessary to navigate the dangerous political landscape of the Murim world. The sect leader's decisions can determine the fate of their entire sect, making this role both prestigious and perilous.

cardPool.title: Yang Energy
cardPool.value: Yang energy, vital in Murim, is linked to the sun and masculinity. Cultivated through intense training, it boosts strength, endurance, and resistance to harsh conditions, often wielded by heroes against evil.
cardPool.description: Yang energy is a type of energy present in the Murim world, that is associated with the sun and masculine traits. It is a vital part of martial arts cultivation, and can be harnessed through intense training of the body and mind. Yang energy grants increased physical strength, endurance, and the ability to endure extreme conditions. It is often used by heroes in battle against evil forces.

cardPool.title: Destroying a Dantian
cardPool.value: In Murim, Dantian is vital for martial artists' cultivation, granting power. Yet, it can be destroyed via physical attacks, poisoning, or pressure points. Dantian destruction is taboo, a punishment for violating codes.
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, Dantian or Qi accumulators are crucial for the cultivation process of martial artists. It is said that a well-cultivated Dantian can grant immense power and strength to an individual. However, there are also ways to destroy a Dantian, rendering a martial artist powerless. This could be done through various techniques, including physical attacks, poisoning, or pressure point manipulation. Dantian destruction is considered a taboo in the Murim world and is often used as a punishment for those who violate their sect or clan's code.

cardPool.title: Pressure Points
cardPool.value: In Murim, martial artists target acupoints to disrupt Qi flow, causing devastating effects.
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, martial artists are trained in the art of striking certain pressure points on their opponent's body to deal significant damage or even incapacitate them. These pressure points, known as acupoints, are specific areas where the flow of Qi can be disrupted. Skilled martial artists can target these acupoints with pinpoint accuracy, causing devastating effects.

cardPool.title: Cultivation Realms
cardPool.value: In the world of Murim, martial artists progress through cultivation realms: Third Rate, Second Rate, First Rate, Expert, Master, Transcendental, Unrestrained, Profound, Life and Death, Natural, Void, and Will. Each realm poses unique challenges, granting access to powerful abilities.
cardPool.description: In the world of Murim, cultivation realms are the stages of progress a martial artist must go through on their journey to become stronger. These realms include Third Rate Realm, Second Rate Realm, First Rate Realm, Expert Realm, Master Realm, Transcendental Realm, Unrestrained Realm, Profound Realm, Life and Death Realm, Natural Realm, Void Realm, and Will Realm. Each realm presents its own unique challenges, with increasingly difficult foes and barriers to overcome. Reaching higher cultivation realms grants access to powerful techniques and abilities.

cardPool.title: The Shadow Assassins
cardPool.value: The Shadow Assassins, secretive and deadly, operate efficiently, hired by Murim factions.
cardPool.description: The Shadow Assassins is a secretive and deadly faction that operates in the shadows. They are known for their ruthless efficiency in eliminating targets and have been hired by various factions in the world of Murim for their services.

cardPool.title: Heir
cardPool.value: Member of powerful family, chosen to inherit leadership. Trained in martial arts, strategy, diplomacy for future role.
cardPool.description: A member of a powerful family or clan, chosen to inherit the leadership role and responsibilities. Heirs are trained from a young age in martial arts, strategy, diplomacy and other skills essential for their future leadership.

cardPool.title: The Righteous Sect
cardPool.value: One of the oldest and most respected sects in Murim. They use martial arts for the greater good, resolving conflicts between factions.
cardPool.description: One of the oldest and most respected sects in the Murim world. They believe in using their martial arts skills for the greater good, and are often called upon to solve conflicts and disputes between other factions.

cardPool.title: Northern Heavenly Sect
cardPool.value: The Northern Heavenly Sect, founded by a legendary warrior, combats the Silent Night with powerful martial arts. They wage a never-ending war against evil. The leader wields a potent martial scroll
cardPool.description: The Northern Heavenly Sect is a powerful militaristic faction focused on combating the Silent Night. Founded by a legendary warrior, this sect trains its members in the most powerful martial arts and weapons. They wage a never-ending war against evil factions and demonic cults. the leader possesses a very powerful ultimate martial scroll.

cardPool.title: Cultivation
cardPool.value: Cultivation, harnessing inner Qi through intense training. Crucial aspect of Murim martial arts. Various sects, unique methods. Highest level grants near superhuman abilities.
cardPool.description: Cultivation is the practice of harnessing and refining one's inner Qi, or energy, through intense training and discipline. It is a crucial aspect of martial arts in the Murim world, with various sects and clans having their own unique methods and techniques. It is said that the highest level of cultivation can grant the practitioner near superhuman abilities, including flight and incredible strength.

cardPool.title: Body Guards
cardPool.value: Body Guards, skilled martial artists, specialize in protecting high-status individuals. Trained in combat, weapons, and defense. Hired by wealthy, powerful, or law enforcement for security.
cardPool.description: Body Guards are highly skilled martial artists who specialize in protecting people of high status. They receive extensive training in hand-to-hand combat, weapons handling, and tactical defense strategies. They are often hired by wealthy individuals, powerful sects, or law enforcement agencies to provide additional security in dangerous situations.

cardPool.title: Qi Master
cardPool.value: The Qi Master, skilled in martial arts and Qi manipulation, strengthens attributes and unleashes powerful techniques.
cardPool.description: The Qi Master is a highly respected and skilled practitioner of martial arts, with a deep understanding of Qi and its utilization. They can control their Qi to strengthen their physical attributes or even unleash powerful techniques.

cardPool.title: Demon Hunter
cardPool.value: Martial artists hunt demons, perfecting techniques to banish evil. Strong and pure-hearted, they withstand demonic energy. Employed to protect villages from supernatural threats.
cardPool.description: A rare class of martial artists who specialize in hunting down demons and their ilk. They train relentlessly to perfect techniques that can banish, exorcise or purify evil spirits. Demon hunters usually have strong innate talents and a pure heart, allowing them to withstand the taint of demonic energy. They are often employed by villages or sects to protect them from supernatural threats.

cardPool.title: The Nine Skies
cardPool.value: The Nine Skies, untouchable rulers of Murim, lead the Central Heavenly Alliance with immense power.
cardPool.description: The Nine Skies are a group of 9 powerful and untouchable figures who rule over Murim and are the leading figures of the Central Heavenly Alliance. They possess immense power.

cardPool.title: Diancang Sect
cardPool.value: Diancang Sect, formidable in Murim, founded over a century ago. Known for secretive practices and misty mountain training. Unique Qi enhances strength, agility, and flexibility. Highly selective in disciple recruitment
cardPool.description: The Diancang Sect is a formidable martial arts sect within the Murim world. Founded over a hundred years ago, the sect is known for its secretive practices and misty mountain training grounds. They use a unique form of Qi to enhance their physical strength while maintaining their agility and flexibility. The Diancang Sect is highly selective in the disciples they accept, often choosing the most talented martial artists from rival sects or wanderers who show great promise.

cardPool.title: Dantian
cardPool.value: Dantian, energy center where Qi is stored for Martial Arts. Three main: Lower (physical), Middle (emotional), Upper (spiritual). Cultivators train to enhance and elevate Qi.
cardPool.description: A Dantian is an energy center in the body where Qi is stored and nurtured for use in Martial Arts. There are three main Dantians in the body: Lower, Middle, and Upper. The Lower Dantian is located below the navel and is associated with physical strength and stamina. The Middle Dantian is at the level of the heart and is linked to emotional stability and balance. The Upper Dantian is located at the forehead and is connected to spiritual and mental power. Cultivators train to enhance their Dantians and elevate their Qi.

cardPool.title: Qi
cardPool.value: Qi or Ki vital energy in Murim. Cultivate for incredible abilities: speed, perception, levitation. Control takes years of training, discipline.
cardPool.description: Qi, or Ki, is the vital energy that flows through all things in the Murim world. Those who cultivate it can unlock incredible abilities and strength, including superhuman speed, sensory perception, and even levitation. However, learning to control and harness Qi takes years of dedication and training, which only the most disciplined martial artists can achieve.

cardPool.title: 3 Types of Paths
cardPool.value: In Murim, martial artists choose three paths: Light (Justice), Demonic (Demons' Way), Evil (Dark). Each with unique focus.
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, martial arts practitioners can choose from three distinct paths or forces to follow. The Light path, also known as the 'Way of the Justice', emphasizes honor, justice, and self-defense. The demonic path, or the 'Way of Demons', centers around their own code of conduct based on their religion. Lastly, the Evil path or 'Way of the Dark', They try gaining as much power and attempt ruling the whole world and brining upon destruction

cardPool.title: Merchant
cardPool.value: Merchants, indispensable in Murim, travel selling rare goods. Some act as spies or intermediaries. Possess sharp wit, silver tongue. Potential for great fortunes or dangerous enemies
cardPool.description: Merchants are not known for their martial prowess in the Murim world, but they are indispensable. They travel across the land, selling rare and exotic goods to individuals and clans alike. Some merchants also act as spies or intermediaries between rival factions. Possessing both sharp wit and a silver tongue, merchants can potentially earn great fortunes or make dangerous enemies.

cardPool.title: Zhuge Family
cardPool.value: The Zhuge family, renowned in the Murim world for strategic prowess, advises both Justice and Evil factions. Their mastery in conflict resolution, not physical combat, commands respect.
cardPool.description: The Zhuge family is known throughout the Murim world as a clan of brilliant strategists and politicians. They are often consulted by both Justice and Evil factions due to their neutral stance and expertise in conflict resolution. While not strong in physical combat, their abilities to manipulate information and outsmart their opponents make them a powerful force to be reckoned with. one of the great families

cardPool.title: Great Families
cardPool.value: In the Murim world, there are great families and sects that hold significant power and influence over the land. Each family/sect has its own distinct culture, beliefs, and martial arts techniques.
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, there are great families and sects that hold significant power and influence over the land. Each family/sect has its own distinct culture, beliefs, and martial arts techniques.

cardPool.title: Demonic Cults
cardPool.value: In Murim, Demonic Cults worship dark entities for power. They follow their own code, seek mastery for unimaginable power. Beware, power comes at cost.
cardPool.description: In the world of Murim, Demonic Cults are religious organizations that worship dark entities for power. They usually do not take part in battles of good versus evil or justice, preferring to follow their own code of conduct. Demonic Cults believe that through proper cultivation and mastery of their dark art, they will be bestowed with unimaginable power. Beware, for their power often comes at a terrible cost.

cardPool.title: The Central Heavenly Alliance
cardPool.value: The Central Heavenly Alliance, led by the Nine Skies, comprises Murim's martial masters. It dominates the mainland as the foremost organization.
cardPool.description: The Central Heavenly Alliance is an organizational alliance comprising of many of the martial masters of Murim. The alliance is headed by the Nine Skies. The Central Heavenly Alliance is the the most prominent organization in Murim and their influence extends far and wide. They are the ruling organization in the mainlands.

cardPool.title: White Orchid Sect
cardPool.value: The White Orchid Sect, a Justice faction, adheres strictly to moral codes. Martial artists utilize orchid-inspired movements, symbolizing grace and inner strength. Renowned for healing using Qi energy.
cardPool.description: The White Orchid Sect is a Justice faction in the Murim world, known for their strict adherence to moral and ethical codes. Their martial artists practice a unique style utilizing the delicate movements of the orchid flower, which they believe symbolizes grace, purity, and inner strength. They are also famous for their healing abilities, using their Qi to channel life energy to heal wounds and cure illnesses.

cardPool.title: Meridians
cardPool.value: Meridians are the pathways through which Qi flows within a person's body. By cultivating and strengthening these meridians, martial artists can increase their power and abilities.
cardPool.description: Meridians are the pathways through which Qi flows within a person's body. By cultivating and strengthening these meridians, martial artists can increase their power and abilities.

cardPool.title: Dragon Warrior
cardPool.value: Dragon Warriors, legendary fighters with unique dragon connection. Strength, agility unmatched. Training grueling, only worthy become Warriors.
cardPool.description: The Dragon Warriors are legendary fighters who have a unique connection with dragons, allowing them to channel their power into their martial arts. Some believe that they are descendants of the dragons themselves, while others say they were blessed by them. Their strength and agility are unmatched, but their training is grueling and perilous. Only the most worthy and determined can hope to become a Dragon Warrior.

cardPool.title: Potential and Talents
cardPool.value: In Murim, potential and talents highly valued. Dantian stores ki potential, increased through cultivation. Divine talents sought after for unique skills. Some may become evil, others devote to justice and honor.
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, potential and talents are highly valued. Everyone has a dantian that stores their ki potential, which can be increased through cultivation techniques. Divine talents that allow for unique abilities and skills are also highly sought after, making their possessor a valuable asset to any sect or clan. However, some with immense potential may fall prey to corruption and become evil, while others may choose to devote themselves to justice and uphold honor.

cardPool.title: Tang Family
cardPool.value: The Tang family, expert in poison martial arts. Noble, aid justice against evil. Values honor, righteousness. One of the great families.
cardPool.description: The Tang family is known for their expert use of poison martial arts. They are a noble family who use their powers for good and often aid the justice factions in their fight against evil. Despite their lethal abilities, the Tang family values honor and righteousness above all else.

cardPool.title: Mount Kunlun Sect
cardPool.value: Great sect in Murim, the Forever Virgins excel in swordplay, enhancing agility with Qi. Female disciples remain chaste for life. Leader revered as a top swordmaster
cardPool.description: One of the great sects in the Murim world, known as the Forever Virgins. They cultivate the art of swordplay and specialize in using their Qi to enhance their agility and speed. Their female disciples are strictly forbidden from marrying and must remain chaste for life. Their leader is revered as one of the greatest swordmasters of all time.

cardPool.title: Habuk-Peng Family
cardPool.value: The Habuk-Peng family, dubbed "Noble Savages," prioritize strength and ferocity in battle. They uphold a strict code of honor.
cardPool.description: The Habuk-Peng family are known as the "Noble Savages" of the Murim world. They prioritize strength above all else and value physical prowess over intelligence or guile. Their members are trained to fight from a young age and are feared for their ferocity in battle. Despite their emphasis on strength, they are known to have a strict code of honor which they abide by at all times.

cardPool.title: Namgung Family
cardPool.value: The Namgung Family, wealthy and prestigious, produces skilled fighters and invests in advanced technology. They uphold a strict code of honor, championing justice and righteousness.
cardPool.description: The Namgung Family is one of the wealthiest and most prestigious clans in the Murim World. They are known to produce some of the most skilled fighters and have heavily invested in the development of advanced technology. Despite their reputation for opulence, they maintain a strict code of honor and stand for justice and righteousness in all their endeavors.

cardPool.title: The Great Sects
cardPool.value: Great Sects, most powerful Clans in Murim. Each with distinct martial arts style, competing for influence. Unique hierarchy, traditions passed down.
cardPool.description: The Great Sects are the most powerful and influential Clans in the Murim world. They each have their own distinct style of martial arts, and are constantly competing for power and influence. Each sect has its own hierarchy and traditions that have been passed down through generations.

cardPool.title: Mount Hua Sect
cardPool.value: Great Sect in Murim, renowned for swordsmanship.
cardPool.description: One of the Great Sects in the Murim world, known for their expertise in swordsmanship.

cardPool.title: Shaolin Sect
cardPool.value: Shaolin Sect, revered in Murim for martial arts mastery sans weapons. Training focuses on Qi manipulation and Dantian cultivation. Adherents of justice, often serve as peacekeepers and advisors
cardPool.description: The Shaolin Sect is a revered faction within the Murim world known for their mastery of martial arts, even without the use of sharp weapons. Their training and discipline focus on Qi manipulation and internal cultivation of the Dantian. They are known for their adherence to justice and righteousness, and often serve as peacekeepers and advisors to emperors and powerful individuals.

cardPool.title: Emei Sect
cardPool.value: Female warriors, righteous and skilled, cultivate inner spirit for powerful sword techniques. Headquarters: Emei Mountain, navigated exclusively by them. Founder, a goddess, brought swordsmanship to humanity
cardPool.description: A sect of female warriors who follow the path of righteousness. They are known for cultivating their inner spirit, and using it to unleash powerful sword techniques. Their headquarter is located in Emei Mountain, a dangerous terrain that only they can navigate. Legend has it that their founder was a goddess who brought the techniques of swordsmanship to humanity.

cardPool.title: Wudang Clan
cardPool.value: Wudang Clan, righteous martial artists following Zhang Sanfeng's Taoist teachings. Value inner balance for strength. Skilled in soft and hard techniques, heal with Qi. Respected mediators in sect conflicts
cardPool.description: The Wudang Clan is a righteous sect of martial artists who follow the Taoist teachings of Zhang Sanfeng. They value inner cultivation and believe that true strength comes from balance of body, mind and spirit. Wudang warriors are skilled in both soft and hard techniques, and are adept at using their Qi to heal the sick. They are respected for their wisdom and often serve as mediators in conflicts between other sects.

cardPool.title: Blade Dancer
cardPool.value: rare martial artists specialized in two-handed sword fighting and graceful acrobatics. Seek physical perfection and grace. Swift strikes, powerful ki. Impressive agility and speed.
cardPool.description: Blade Dancers are a rare class of martial artists that specialize in two-handed sword fighting combined with graceful acrobatics. Unlike other fighters, Blade Dancers seek not just physical perfection, but also the beauty and grace that comes from their movements. With swift strikes and powerful ki, they can cut through enemies like a dance through the air. Their control of ki also allows them to perform impressive feats of agility and speed on the battlefield.

cardPool.title: Celestial Immortal
cardPool.value: Celestial Immortals, martial arts pinnacle. Ascended to heavens as divine beings. Symbol of hope, power moves mountains with a flick.
cardPool.description: The Celestial Immortals are legendary figures who have reached the pinnacle of martial arts and cultivation. They are said to have ascended to the heavens, where they reside as divine beings. Their presence is a symbol of hope and their power is unparalleled, capable of moving mountains with a flick of their finger.

cardPool.title: Assassin
cardPool.value: Assassins in Murim, skilled in stealth and deadly precision. Some neutral, taking contracts. Others allied with factions for covert operations. Feared by many, always work in secret.
cardPool.description: Assassins in the Murim world are shrouded in mystery and skilled in the art of stealth. These shadowy figures are known for their deadly precision, using their blades to swiftly eliminate enemies without detection. Some Assassin clans remain neutral, taking contracts from any who can afford their services. Others are allied with factions, using their skills to carry out covert operations or as a last resort against powerful foes. Regardless of their allegiances, Assassins always work in secret and are feared by many.

cardPool.title: Disciple
cardPool.value: Disciple, martial arts student, seeks mastery and skill cultivation. Found in Murim sects and clans. Specializes in Qi techniques or weapon mastery.
cardPool.description: A Disciple is a student of martial arts who seeks to learn from a master and cultivate their skills. They are often found in various sects and clans throughout the Murim world, dedicating their lives to honing their abilities and becoming stronger. Disciples may specialize in different types of martial arts, such as Qi-based techniques or weapon mastery.

cardPool.title: Mercenary
cardPool.value: Mercenaries, hired fighters offering skills to highest bidder. taking jobs for sects or clans. Skilled and adaptable, able to tackle any challenge.
cardPool.description: Mercenaries are hired fighters who offer their skills and services to the highest bidder. They are often found in the Murim world, taking jobs for sects or clans who need extra manpower or specialized skills. Mercenaries come from a variety of backgrounds and can specialize in anything from martial arts to espionage. They are known for being skilled and adaptable fighters, able to take on any challenge thrown at them with ease.

cardPool.title: Noble
cardPool.value: In Murim, Nobles hold immense power as leaders of sects or clans. Respected, commanding loyalty. Known for manners, elegance, fighting skills. Some succumb to ambition, leading to tragic ends..
cardPool.description: In the Murim world, Nobles are high-ranking individuals who hold immense power and influence. Most often seen as leaders of sects or clans, Nobles are respected by those around them and command loyalty from their followers. They are known for their refined manners, elegance, and great fighting skills. However, with great power comes great responsibility, and some Nobles succumb to their own ambition or personal demons, leading to tragic ends.

cardPool.title: The Light Path
cardPool.value: The Light Path, one of three in Murim. Followers protect justice, promote harmony. Use martial arts for greater good, even at risk. Form alliances with like-minded sects.
cardPool.description: The Light Path, one of three in Murim. Followers protect justice, promote harmony. Use martial arts for greater good, even at risk. Form alliances with like-minded sects.

cardPool.title: Blade Sect
cardPool.value: A martial arts sect renowned for its mastery of swordsmanship and combat techniques. Led by the formidable Blade Master, the sect trains its disciples in the art of the sword, emphasizing discipline, precision, and mastery of the blade.
cardPool.description: A martial arts sect renowned for its mastery of swordsmanship and combat techniques. Led by the formidable Blade Master, the sect trains its disciples in the art of the sword, emphasizing discipline, precision, and mastery of the blade.

cardPool.title: Outliers
cardPool.value: Outliers are a rare group of individuals in the Murim world who possess abilities that defy categorization. They do not belong to any sect or clan and are often ostracized by both good and evil factions. Some Outliers manifest powers that can rival gods while others possess unique skills that allow them to outwit opponents in battle. Though their origins are shrouded in mystery, they are feared and respected by all for their unpredictable nature.

cardPool.title: Cultivation Techniques
cardPool.value: Cultivation techniques, also known as martial arts techniques or skills, are fundamental to the practice of martial arts in the Murim world. These techniques encompass a wide range of abilities, from enhancing strength and speed to controlling elements like fire and water. They are often passed down within sects and clans as closely guarded secrets, and become a defining characteristic of their practitioners. Mastering these techniques requires intensive training and the cultivation of one's Qi to achieve great power.

cardPool.title: Smallfolk
cardPool.value: Smallfolk are common people in the Murim world who lack the ability to use Ki. They are often looked down upon by those who possess martial abilities, but can still become skilled in various non-Ki-related trades such as crafting and medicine. Smallfolk may also band together to form communities or work under the protection of a more powerful sect or clan.

cardPool.title: Sun Moon Holy Cult
cardPool.value: A powerful and secretive organization that operates behind the scenes, the Sun Moon Holy Cult seeks to manipulate and control the Murim world for its own ends. Led by the enigmatic Nine Arts Dragon, the cult employs ruthless methods to achieve its objectives, including coercion, assassination, and manipulation of key figures.

cardPool.title: Strategist
cardPool.value: The Strategist is a mastermind who excels in battle planning and strategic maneuvers. They are essential to any sect or clan, and their intelligence can tip the scales of warfare in their favor. Strategists rely on their keen observation, analysis, and prediction skills to stay one step ahead of the enemy. Their ultimate goal is to secure victory for their faction, minimizing casualties and damage.

cardPool.title: Martial Artist
cardPool.value: Martial artists are individuals who have mastered the art of combat through rigorous training and cultivation of their Qi. They come from various sects and clans in the Murim world, each with their own unique fighting style and techniques. Martial artists are revered for their strength and discipline, and often find themselves embroiled in conflicts between different factions. Some use their abilities to uphold justice and protect the innocent, while others seek power and domination at any cost.

cardPool.title: Legendary Weapons
cardPool.value: These weapons are typically imbued with mystical properties, forged by legendary craftsmen, or infused with the essence of powerful beings. They are coveted by warriors and martial artists alike, for their immense power and historical significance. Many Legendary Weapons have unique abilities or curses that only those with the necessary skill and knowledge can wield. Some are even said to be sentient, possessing a will of their own and choosing their own wielders.

cardPool.title: Spiritualists
cardPool.value: Spiritualists are a rare class of martial artists who have dedicated their lives to mastering the art of spiritual energy. They have learned to tap into the power of their souls, unlocking magical abilities that can heal, protect, and even attack their opponents. Spiritualists are revered for their wisdom and insight, and many seek out their guidance when facing moral quandaries or trying to connect with the spiritual realm.

cardPool.title: Beastmasters
cardPool.value: Beastmasters are individuals who have devoted themselves to the training and taming of various animals. They possess a deep connection with nature and can communicate and control beasts with ease. Often used as scouts or in battles, Beastmasters are highly respected in the Murim world for their unique abilities and contribution to their sects or clans.

cardPool.title: Necromancers
cardPool.value: Necromancers are a feared and misunderstood class in the Murim world. They possess the ability to control and communicate with the dead, often using their powers for their own gain or as tools for revenge. Many sects consider them taboo, but some see their skills as necessary for protecting the realm against evil forces.

cardPool.title: Celestial Realms
cardPool.value: The Celestial Realms are a mystical location, shrouded in mystery. It is said to be the highest realm within the Murim world, and only the most powerful martial artists are able to access it. Legends say that the Celestial Realms contain vast treasures, powerful artifacts, and secrets that could change the course of history. However, it is also rumored to be guarded by powerful beings, and only those with pure hearts and intentions may enter without facing dire consequences.

cardPool.title: Monk
cardPool.value: Monks are highly disciplined martial artists, known for their fighting prowess and spiritual enlightenment. They train both their bodies and minds to reach a state of inner peace, and use their Ki to perform incredible feats of strength and agility in combat. Monks often belong to sects or temples, where they learn ancient techniques and meditate to further their understanding of the universe.

cardPool.title: Arts
cardPool.value: practitioners learn various martial arts styles, each with unique characteristics. Some sects specialize, others teach combinations. Cultivating Qi and mastering one's art unlocks full potential.
cardPool.description: In the world of Murim, there are various martial arts styles that practitioners can learn. Each style has its unique characteristics and techniques, making them effective in different situations. Some sects specialize in a particular art, while others teach a combination of multiple styles. One must cultivate their Qi and master their chosen art to unlock their full potential.

cardPool.title: Dual-Blade Technique Arts
cardPool.value: Dual-blade masters wield two weapons, enhancing offense and defense. They emphasize coordination, speed, and fluid movement to overwhelm opponents. This style demands extreme focus and is for skilled fighters.
cardPool.description: Masters of dual-blade technique wield two weapons simultaneously, increasing their offensive capabilities while maintaining defensive versatility. This style emphasizes coordination, speed, and fluidity of movement to overwhelm opponents with a barrage of attacks. This martial arts style requires extreme focus and is only recommended for the most skilled fighters.

cardPool.title: Spear Arts
cardPool.value: Spear arts are vital in Murim. Practitioners control their spear with precision, using Ki to strike, deflect attacks, and launch powerful strikes. Sects specialize in styles like Dragon Spear or Flowing Water.
cardPool.description: Spear arts are a prominent form of weapons-based combat in the Murim world. Spear art practitioners utilize their Ki to control their spear with deadly precision. A true spear art master can utilize their spear as an extension of their own body, using it to strike from a distance, deflect incoming attacks, and even launch powerful Ki attacks. Some sects specialize in certain forms of spear arts, such as the Dragon Spear Style or the Flowing Water Spear Style.

cardPool.title: Spiritual Martial Arts
cardPool.value: Spiritual martial arts focus on harmonizing mind, body, and spirit to achieve mastery over one's inner and outer selves. Practitioners may draw upon meditation, breathing exercises, and spiritual enlightenment to enhance their combat abilities and achieve transcendence in battle.
cardPool.description: Spiritual martial arts focus on harmonizing mind, body, and spirit to achieve mastery over one's inner and outer selves. Practitioners may draw upon meditation, breathing exercises, and spiritual enlightenment to enhance their combat abilities and achieve transcendence in battle.

cardPool.title: Illusionary Arts
cardPool.value: Illusionary Arts is practiced by the Illusionary Sect, utilizing Ki to create illusions that confuse opponents. Skilled practitioners can even create illusions causing physical harm. Mental discipline is crucial, as overly powerful illusions can harm the user.
cardPool.description: Illusionary Arts is a unique form of martial arts practiced by the Illusionary Sect. It involves using one's Ki to create realistic illusions that can confuse and disorient opponents. The most skilled practitioners of Illusionary Arts can even create illusions that can physically harm their opponents. However, the use of Illusionary Arts requires a great deal of mental discipline, as creating illusions that are too powerful can backfire and harm the user instead.

cardPool.title: Healing Arts
cardPool.value: In Murim, Healing Arts are vital. Healers manipulate Ki, mending wounds by enhancing recovery abilities, saving lives on and off the battlefield, highly respected in sects and clans alike.
cardPool.description: In the world of Murim, Healing Arts are a well-respected and much-needed practice. Practitioners of Healing Arts are highly respected in sects and clans alike, as they possess skills that can save lives on and off the battlefield. The healers use their abilities to manipulate Ki and mend wounds by stimulating blood flow, accelerating cell regeneration, and enhancing one's body recovery abilities.

cardPool.title: Fist Arts
cardPool.value: Hand-to-hand combat techniques are fundamental in Murim stories, with characters often proficient in striking, grappling, and joint locks. Examples include Boxing, Muay Thai, Judo, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

cardPool.title: Heavenly Destruction Sect
cardPool.value: The Heavenly Destruction Sect, feared and powerful in the Murim world, stops at nothing to increase influence. Known for brutal training methods and secret techniques, disciples achieve unparalleled strength. Despite unethical ways, many flock to gain power and prestige.
cardPool.description: The Heavenly Destruction Sect is one of the most feared and powerful martial arts sect in the Murim world. Ruthless in their pursuit of power and dominance, they will stop at nothing to increase their influence. The sect is known for their brutal training methods and secret techniques that allow their disciples to achieve unparalleled strength. Though their ways are often seen as unethical, many still flock to join their ranks, hoping to gain power and prestige in their world.

cardPool.title: Pills
cardPool.value: In the Murim world, Pills are a crucial component for Cultivation and increasing one's power. These pills are created using rare and valuable materials such as herbs, minerals, and even the internal organs of beasts. The quality of a pill can greatly affect its potency and even determine whether or not it will cause harm to the user. Many sects and clans have their own unique recipes for pills, and some pills have become legendary for their effects, such as the Immortal Ascension Pill which can grant immortality to those who consume it.

cardPool.title: Sealed Techniques
cardPool.value: In the Murim world, there exist powerful martial arts techniques that are so dangerous or forbidden that they must be sealed away. These Sealed Techniques can only be accessed under specific conditions or by those who possess special abilities. Some believe that the use of Sealed Techniques can bring disaster, while others seek them out for their immense power. Regardless, those who seek to unlock these techniques must tread carefully, as the consequences of failure are dire.

cardPool.title: Elixirs
cardPool.value: In the world of Murim, elixirs are highly valued for their ability to enhance a martial artist's power and increase their lifespan. These potent potions can be made from a variety of rare and exotic ingredients, often requiring expert knowledge and skill to create. Some elixirs can even grant temporary immortality, allowing those who drink them to survive deadly battles and heal from grave injuries. However, elixirs are also heavily guarded and coveted by powerful factions, leading to fierce competition and even deadly conflict.

cardPool.title: Trascendental Realm
cardPool.value: In the trascendental realm, martial artists have achieved a level beyond the conventional mastery, the perfect mastery. The trascendental realm is gained after breaking through the third wall, it is divided into Transcendent Master stage, Transcendent Grand Master stage, and Trascendent Supreme Master stage.

cardPool.title: Expert Realm
cardPool.value: Gained after breaking through the first wall,  In the Expert realm there are martial artists that enhance their mastery over techniques. the Expert Realm is divided into three stages: Inept Expert, Expert, and Advanced Expert.

cardPool.title: commoner
cardPool.value: commoners are the backbone of society. They have not yet tapped into the power of cultivation, either due to lack of talent or simply being untrained.

cardPool.title: Third Rate Realm
cardPool.value: third rate is the entry-level realm, where individuals begin Qi cultivation. These martial artists are the weakest in the martial arts world.

cardPool.title: The Void Realm
cardPool.value: The Void realm is the second highest realm possible to achieve. Individuals in the Void Realm know the truth of the universe and the concept of emptiness. Void Masters possess infinite internal energy and can manipulate space itself.

cardPool.title: Second Rate Realm
cardPool.value: Second Rate are experienced warriors who have grasped the basics of internal energy and are beginning to learn combat techniques.

cardPool.title: The Will Realm
cardPool.value: The Will Realm is the ultimate Realm. Willful Masters transcend human limitations to join the realm of gods. Willful Masters go beyond the five senses and can manipulate the universe at will. They are omnipotent, capable of healing, stopping time, and surpassing all aspects of the universe, including space, time, and reality.

cardPool.title: Master Realm
cardPool.value: In the Master Realm, martial artists have achieved mastery and internal energy control. It is gained after breaking through the second wall. It is divided into Master stage, Grand Master stage, and Peak Master Stage.

cardPool.title: First Rate Realm
cardPool.value: First Rate Realm are elite warriors who have completed their foundational training. They start shaping Qi, increasing their internal energy, and honing techniques for higher levels.

cardPool.title: Profound Realm
cardPool.value: The Profound Realm is an higher realm than Unrestrained Realm. In the Profound Realm, individuals have a deep connection with internal energy and environment, having obtained extreme balance of the Yin and Yang Qi after breaking through the Fifth Wall. It is a place of profound mastery and enlightenment in martial arts.

cardPool.title: Life and Death Realm
cardPool.value: After the sixth wall breakthrough, there is the Life and Death Realm. It is higher than Profound Realm. It consists of the Divine Master Stage and is considered the pinnacle of martial arts. Reaching higher levels is considered almost impossible. Individuals in the Life and Death Realm achieve fly abilities and can shatter space.

cardPool.title: Unrestrained Realm
cardPool.value: the Unrestrained Realm is higher realm than Transcendental Realm. In the Unrestrained Realm, masters of martial arts are among the top forces. They have achieved a perfect completion in one circle. It is divided into Unrestrained Master stage, Unrestrained Grand Master stage and Unrestrained Supreme Master Stage. It is achieved after breaking through fifth wall.

cardPool.title: Divine Palaces
cardPool.value: Divine Palaces are several and each home powerful sects practice martial arts and cultivate their Ki reach divine levels power. These palaces are located in the most remote and sacred locations, where only the most worthy and skilled aspirants can find them. Legends say that each Divine Palace has a unique set of teachings and techniques that have been passed down for generations, and that those who master them can achieve near-impossible feats of strength and agility.

These palaces are said to be located in the most remote and sacred locations, where only the most worthy and skilled aspirants can find them. Legends say that each Divine Palace has a unique set of teachings and techniques that have been passed down for generations, and that those who master them can achieve near-impossible feats of strength and agility.

cardPool.title: Blood Sect
cardPool.value: The Blood Sect is a sinister cult that thrives on chaos and suffering, believing that the world must be purged through bloodshed to achieve true enlightenment. Their followers are known for their brutal rituals and use of forbidden blood magic.

cardPool.title: Eclipse Sect
cardPool.value: The Eclipse Sect worships the eternal darkness, seeking to plunge the world into an unending night where only the strongest survive. They are masters of shadow techniques and assassinations, operating from the shadows to destabilize the Murim world.

cardPool.title: Soul Cult
cardPool.value: Soul is a demonic sect that practices soul manipulation and necromancy, harvesting the life force of their victims to fuel their dark powers. They are feared for their ability to control the dead and their insatiable hunger for souls.

cardPool.title: Sect Member
cardPool.value: A Sect Member belongs to one of the many martial arts sects in the Murim world. Unlike typical martial artists, Sect Members focus on mastering a single technique to perfection. They train in communal settings and often participate in group battles, relying on synchronized movements. Their ultimate goal is to protect their sect and uphold its traditions. Sect Members also engage in daily chores and contribute to the sect's well-being, making them integral to the community's functioning.
